Base directory for this skill: <PLUGIN>\skills\wiki-maintainer

# Maintain content and perform requested app actions

Repair the requested knowledge or navigation while preserving its evidence and
other writers' work. A report alone does not authorize edits; a search answer does
not authorize filing. Pure filesystem maintenance needs no running app.

## Workflow

1. Read [access](references/access.md), resolve the known vault and absolute
   installed helpers, and open its applicable instructions. Select the requested
   action below; use [wiki-setup](../wiki-setup/SKILL.md) for report-only work.
2. Inspect the exact pages, current evidence and requested scope. Read
   [evidence](references/evidence.md) before factual changes and
   [identity and relationships](references/efficacy.md) before concept/navigation
   changes. Use the relevant direct setup check to establish the baseline.
3. Before a content or pipeline-state write, read
   [operation completion](references/operations.md), open or reuse the owned
   operation and retain the exact-path ledger. Native actions use the guarded
   adapter; a UI-only action does not require a content operation.
4. Make only justified changes. Preserve raw bodies, restrictions and factual
   review dates on mechanical edits. If support is missing or the intended change
   is uncertain, report the concrete remaining decision instead of inventing it.
5. Recheck the requested effect and [validate the changed paths](../wiki-setup/references/validation.md).
   Refresh affected owned catalogs, log once, close the scoped operation, sync and
   verify publication unless the user holds it. Report actual results and blockers.

## Modes and examples

- **Integrity repair:** read [repair](references/repair.md).
  Request: “Fix this broken citation.” Action: read the citing claim and exact
  source, repair its path within scope, compare issue IDs with the
  [health check](../wiki-setup/references/checks.md#health-and-ingest-backlog).
  Result: a verified citation repair and scoped publication, with unresolved IDs named.
- **Factual correction:** read [factual maintenance](references/lint.md).
  Request: “Correct the unsupported quotation on this page.” Action: inspect the
  [lint finding](../wiki-setup/references/checks.md#content-lint-report) and raw passage,
  correct or mark the claim, then record the reviewed disposition. Result: supported
  text and an honest factual-review date, without changing the raw clipping.
- **Relationships and navigation:** read [relink](references/relink.md).
  Request: “Connect queue ordering to retry budgets.” Action: read both pages,
  accept only an explained relationship and update the relevant task map.
  Result: a useful navigational link with its limits, not an unsupported causal claim.
- **Triage:** read [triage](references/triage.md).
  Request: “Show the capture issues from this research run.” Action: present the
  queue's token-bearing link and topic summary. Result: the user can disposition
  the issues; opening the queue does not apply re-clips or quarantine. When asked
  to apply selected dispositions, act on those selections, validate affected
  content and complete the owned operation.
- **Authorized synthesis filing:** read [synthesis filing](references/synthesis-filing.md).
  Request: “File this cited answer as a synthesis.” Action: verify its provenance,
  reuse or create the proper synthesis and complete a **query** operation.
  Result: a sourced, validated, published page. Original project prose routes to
  [wiki-project](../wiki-project/SKILL.md).
- **Native action:** read [Obsidian actions](references/obsidian-cli.md).
  Request: “Open the Beacon architecture note in Obsidian.” Action: invoke the
  guarded helper with the exact note path. Result: the requested app action, or a
  specific unavailable-action report using [app diagnostics](../wiki-setup/references/app-access.md).
  A filesystem read is never reported as a successful UI action.

## Best practices

Compare resolved, remaining and new issue IDs rather than chasing a score. A
clean graph is not factual verification. Keep checks bounded to the task; skip
empty-vault or unchanged-wiki semantic sweeps. Distinguish preview from apply,
and inspect the target after an uncertain native mutation before retrying.

## Advanced references

Load [repair recipes and the hash-join contract](references/maintenance.md) only
for the indicated repair; [workflow overview](references/workflows.md) only to
compare roles. Required check procedures are directly available in
[checks](../wiki-setup/references/checks.md), [validation](../wiki-setup/references/validation.md)
and [operation recovery](../wiki-setup/references/operation-recovery.md).
Removal retains separate approval boundaries in [wiki-purge](../wiki-purge/SKILL.md).

## Done

The requested effects are verified, remaining issues and coverage limits are
stated, and every owned content mutation is validated and accounted for through
publication or an explicit hold/local-only/blocker. Preview-only work has no
content operation, log, commit or refresh.

1	Read directly for this operation: [access](access.md).
2	Select the calling workflow before mutations; CLI syntax alone does not authorize writes.
3	
4	# Driving the Obsidian CLI
5	
6	The vault is targeted by name: `obsidian vault=<name> <command> ...`. wiki-master
7	resolves `<name>` from `WIKI_MASTER_VAULT_NAME` or the vault folder's basename, and
8	its **filesystem path** from `WIKI_MASTER_VAULT`, defaulting to `~/.wiki-master-vault`
9	(this convention lives in `scripts/lib/vault.mjs` — the bundled scripts use it, so
10	`node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/health.mjs"` and friends need no path argument). Start there rather than
11	searching the disk for the vault.
12	`file=` resolves by name (like wikilinks); `path=` is an exact vault-relative path.
13	Invoke commands through `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/obsidian.mjs" <command> ...`
14	or the `scripts/lib/vault.mjs` API. Never bypass it with native CLI calls or run
15	parallel native commands. The shared lock has a bounded wait; busy means not sent.
16	Oversized or physically multiline requests are rejected before launch. Ordinary
17	Markdown bodies go through filesystem editing, even when the CLI works. Do not
18	chunk a rejected note into repeated CLI writes. Inspect the exact target first if
19	an earlier write's outcome is uncertain. See the directly linked access contract.
20	The guarded `vault info=path` command can confirm the root
21	when the app responds; the known configured/default root supports filesystem access
22	without that probe.
23	
24	## Access failures and empty results
25	
26	Use the direct [app-access diagnosis](../../wiki-setup/references/app-access.md) for Windows invocation, lazy canary checks, failure/refusal and uncertain mutations. Do not probe before every action; no app is required for independent filesystem work. Before retrying any timed-out mutation, inspect the actual target.
27	
28	## Syntax and the live contract
29	- **Parameters take `=`; flags are bare.** `create name="My Note" content="Hello"`
30	  vs `create name=Note open overwrite`. `\n` / `\t` for multiline content.
31	- **`vault=<name>` must be the first parameter**, before the command.
32	- **`format=` is a parameter, not a flag**, and its default varies per command —
33	  `search` defaults to `text`, `backlinks`/`tags`/`properties` to `tsv`,
34	  `base:query` to `json`. Never assume JSON; ask for it.
35	- **`node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/obsidian.mjs" help` outranks the docs.** Obsidian's own skill says it "is always
36	  up to date" — so when the published reference and the binary disagree, the
37	  binary wins. Check `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/obsidian.mjs" help <command>` before concluding a flag is gone.
38	- Prior art worth comparing against: kepano (Obsidian's CEO) publishes a
39	  first-party `obsidian-cli` Agent Skill. Where it and this skill agree — `total`
40	  for counts, `file=` vs `path=`, vault-first ordering — the agreement is
41	  independent corroboration, not inheritance.
42	
43	## Read / search
44	- `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/obsidian.mjs" read path=wiki/concepts/alpha.md`
45	- `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/obsidian.mjs" search query="tag:clippings neural" path=wiki limit=10 format=json`
46	- Scope to `path=wiki` by default — `raw/` holds immutable source dumps (one
47	  clipping can contain a long document) and belongs in results only when asked.
48	- Probe cost before fetching: `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/obsidian.mjs" search query="..." total` (a count only).
49	- **Never default to `search:context`** — it returns every matching line from
50	  every file, and
51	  `limit=` bounds files, not lines, so it cannot save you. Escalate to
52	  `search:context` only with both `path=` and a narrow query.
53	
54	## Links & graph
55	- `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/obsidian.mjs" backlinks file=alpha counts` — who links here
56	- `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/obsidian.mjs" links file=alpha` — outgoing links
57	- `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/obsidian.mjs" unresolved verbose format=json` — broken links WITH source files.
58	  The bare form returns targets only; `verbose` is the difference between a
59	  defect you can act on and a string you can't attribute. Several subcommands
60	  have lossy defaults with a `verbose` escape — prefer `format=json verbose`.
61	- For content health use the direct [filesystem checks](../../wiki-setup/references/checks.md#health-and-ingest-backlog), not app `orphans`/`deadends` as repair metrics.
62	
63	## Typed properties (frontmatter)
64	- `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/obsidian.mjs" property:set name=reviewed value=2026-07-15 type=date path=wiki/concepts/alpha.md`
65	- `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/obsidian.mjs" property:read name=reviewed path=...`
66	- `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/obsidian.mjs" properties path=...` — list a note's properties
67	
68	## Create / edit / move
69	- Create, replace or append ordinary Markdown through exact-path filesystem edits
70	  under the known root, using the shared operation lifecycle. Preserve current
71	  content and raw evidence. Do not send substantial text through the CLI.
72	- `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/obsidian.mjs" move file=foo to=wiki/entities`
73	
74	## Tags, tasks, templates, bases
75	- `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/obsidian.mjs" tags counts` · `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/obsidian.mjs" tag name=neural verbose`
76	- `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/obsidian.mjs" base:query file=stale.base view=all format=json`
77	- `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/obsidian.mjs" template:insert name=source-note`
78	
79	## Escape hatches
80	- `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/obsidian.mjs" command id=<id>` — run any Obsidian command (`node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/obsidian.mjs" commands` to list)
81	- `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/obsidian.mjs" eval code="<js>"` — arbitrary JS in app context (last resort).
82	  **This is remote code execution against the vault**, and it sits in the same
83	  namespace as the read-only subcommands: a blanket `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/obsidian.mjs" *` permission grant
84	  covers it. It belongs in its own permission decision, not folded in with
85	  `search` and `read`. The same applies to `dev:cdp` and `dev:debug`.
86	
87	If a command fails, report its diagnostic and use
88	[app failure recovery](../../wiki-setup/references/app-access.md#failure-refusal-and-uncertain-mutation).
89	Never claim a filesystem fallback performed an app-only action. For content
90	mutations, retain [operation completion](operations.md) and direct
91	[scoped validation](../../wiki-setup/references/validation.md); UI-only actions do
92	not manufacture content operations.
93

1	# Vault access and host commands
2	
3	Resolve the plugin root from the installed `SKILL.md` location, not the current
4	working directory: its containing skill folder's `../../` is the plugin root.
5	From a file in a skill's `references/` folder, use `../../../` instead.
6	Resolve and quote absolute helper paths before running commands. Treat
7	`$ARGUMENTS` as the user's request when the host has not substituted it. A linked
8	skill or reference can be read directly when the host has no skill loader; shared
9	policy does not require loading the maintenance-role entry point.
10	Resolve `WIKI_MASTER_VAULT` (default `~/.wiki-master-vault`; with `WIKI_MASTER_REQUIRE_VAULT=1` set and no vault named, a script stops with exit 2 instead of using the default) and inspect only the expected
11	vault paths needed by the task. Read local `AGENTS.md` and schema before edits. A known root and
12	filesystem access are sufficient for the supported operations below; do not ask
13	the user to restart Obsidian as a prerequisite for all work.
14	
15	## Layout and read scope
16	
17	`raw/clippings/` holds captured evidence; `wiki/{sources,entities,concepts,syntheses,authored}/`
18	holds maintained pages; `moc/` holds navigational maps; `log/` holds one file per
19	operation. Never read, cite or count `.recycle/`; only purge owns it. Reads do not
20	open operations, write logs, commit or refresh indexes. Before any authorized
21	mutation, read [operation completion](operations.md); before quoting or
22	synthesizing, read [evidence](evidence.md).
23	
24	Prefer bounded search and relevant MOCs to the generated catalog. Search
25	diagnostics describe coverage, not relevance: a stale index can omit useful pages.
26	Read current passages and disclose weak or failed channels. Index freshness is
27	distinct from factual review dates.
28	
29	## Choose the supported channel
30	
31	| Operation | Channel and fallback |
32	|---|---|
33	| Read a Markdown page or source | CLI `read path=...`, or read its exact path under the known vault root. |
34	| Search | Prefer `search.mjs` and inspect its diagnostics. If a channel fails, use available results plus bounded filesystem `rg` over `wiki/` and `moc/`; include `raw/clippings/` only for evidence lookup. State missing channels. |
35	| Health, evidence routes, identity, relationships, drift coverage | Bundled filesystem helpers work without Obsidian. Do not gate them on `assertRunning`. Drift embeddings still require their backend. |
36	| Factual freshness report | `stale.mjs` may use CLI discovery or scoped filesystem fallback. Preserve missing-review and coverage diagnostics. |
37	| Ordinary Markdown creation/editing | Use exact-path filesystem edits even when the CLI is healthy, with the same operation, evidence, schema and validation contract. Read current content before editing; preserve unrelated changes. Never pass a whole note body through `content=`. |
38	| Small typed property or app actions | Use the guarded CLI entry point below; filesystem property edits remain available with schema validation. |
39	| Opening a note in the UI, executing an Obsidian/plugin command, app state, live Bases queries | Requires working Obsidian CLI. Report the specific unavailable action; continue independent file work. Do not pretend a filesystem approximation executed an app action. |
40	
41	For CLI calls use `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/obsidian.mjs" <command> ...`
42	or the bundled `scripts/lib/vault.mjs` API. These share an OS-managed lock across
43	agent processes, vaults and plugin copies for the same user. Do not launch native
44	`obsidian` directly or bypass a busy guard; other tools' raw calls are not protected.
45	The guard waits up to 10 seconds for a turn, then fails without sending a request.
46	Command execution has its own 10-second default timeout. Each request is limited
47	to a conservative 2,048-byte UTF-8 JSON envelope and rejects physical CR/LF/NUL.
48	This policy is not Obsidian's documented maximum. If rejected before sending,
49	use filesystem Markdown editing or narrow the read query; do not split a note
50	into many CLI writes or disable the guard. No fallback performs writes implicitly.
51	For unavailable, rejected or uncertain requests, follow the direct
52	[app diagnosis](../../wiki-setup/references/app-access.md#failure-refusal-and-uncertain-mutation).
53	A timed-out mutation has an uncertain outcome: inspect the exact target before
54	retrying or switching channels. Never claim a filesystem fallback executed an
55	app-only action. No fallback implicitly authorizes a write.
56	
57	Validate resolved paths stay under the known root. Restrict searches to explicit
58	content directories; exclude `.recycle/`, dot folders, dependency trees and binary
59	originals. Do not recursively enumerate the entire user profile or scan a recycled
60	topic. Raw bodies remain immutable even during fallback. If target content changed
61	since it was read, reconcile it before writing; do not overwrite concurrent work.
62	
63	## Shell portability
64	
65	Examples elsewhere use `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/health.mjs"` as command
66	notation. Replace the placeholder with the actual installed absolute path before
67	execution, and set the vault for the operation's scope. Do not execute literal
68	angle-bracket placeholders or assume a relative `scripts/` path means the plugin.
69	
70	PowerShell (restore any prior environment value):
71	
72	```powershell
73	$wikiPriorVault = $env:WIKI_MASTER_VAULT
74	try {
75	  $env:WIKI_MASTER_VAULT = 'C:/absolute/path/to/vault'
76	  node 'C:/absolute/installed/plugin/scripts/health.mjs'
77	  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Wiki health failed' }
78	} finally {
79	  $env:WIKI_MASTER_VAULT = $wikiPriorVault
80	}
81	```
82	
83	POSIX shell (one command's environment only):
84	
85	```sh
86	WIKI_MASTER_VAULT='/absolute/path/to/vault' node '/absolute/installed/plugin/scripts/health.mjs'
87	```
88	
89	For Windows redirector and empty-output diagnosis, read
90	[app access](../../wiki-setup/references/app-access.md#windows-invocation) only
91	when needed. These reporting examples are read-only: no operation or rebuild is
92	needed to answer a question.
93

# Vault access and host commands

Resolve the plugin root from the installed `SKILL.md` location, not the current
working directory: its containing skill folder's `../../` is the plugin root.
From a file in a skill's `references/` folder, use `../../../` instead.
Resolve and quote absolute helper paths before running commands. Treat
`$ARGUMENTS` as the user's request when the host has not substituted it. A linked
skill or reference can be read directly when the host has no skill loader; shared
policy does not require loading the maintenance-role entry point.
Resolve `WIKI_MASTER_VAULT` (default `~/.wiki-master-vault`; with `WIKI_MASTER_REQUIRE_VAULT=1` set and no vault named, a script stops with exit 2 instead of using the default) and inspect only the expected
vault paths needed by the task. Read local `AGENTS.md` and schema before edits. A known root and
filesystem access are sufficient for the supported operations below; do not ask
the user to restart Obsidian as a prerequisite for all work.

## Layout and read scope

`raw/clippings/` holds captured evidence; `wiki/{sources,entities,concepts,syntheses,authored}/`
holds maintained pages; `moc/` holds navigational maps; `log/` holds one file per
operation. Never read, cite or count `.recycle/`; only purge owns it. Reads do not
open operations, write logs, commit or refresh indexes. Before any authorized
mutation, read [operation completion](operations.md); before quoting or
synthesizing, read [evidence](evidence.md).

Prefer bounded search and relevant MOCs to the generated catalog. Search
diagnostics describe coverage, not relevance: a stale index can omit useful pages.
Read current passages and disclose weak or failed channels. Index freshness is
distinct from factual review dates.

## Choose the supported channel

| Operation | Channel and fallback |
|---|---|
| Read a Markdown page or source | CLI `read path=...`, or read its exact path under the known vault root. |
| Search | Prefer `search.mjs` and inspect its diagnostics. If a channel fails, use available results plus bounded filesystem `rg` over `wiki/` and `moc/`; include `raw/clippings/` only for evidence lookup. State missing channels. |
| Health, evidence routes, identity, relationships, drift coverage | Bundled filesystem helpers work without Obsidian. Do not gate them on `assertRunning`. Drift embeddings still require their backend. |
| Factual freshness report | `stale.mjs` may use CLI discovery or scoped filesystem fallback. Preserve missing-review and coverage diagnostics. |
| Ordinary Markdown creation/editing | Use exact-path filesystem edits even when the CLI is healthy, with the same operation, evidence, schema and validation contract. Read current content before editing; preserve unrelated changes. Never pass a whole note body through `content=`. |
| Small typed property or app actions | Use the guarded CLI entry point below; filesystem property edits remain available with schema validation. |
| Opening a note in the UI, executing an Obsidian/plugin command, app state, live Bases queries | Requires working Obsidian CLI. Report the specific unavailable action; continue independent file work. Do not pretend a filesystem approximation executed an app action. |

For CLI calls use `node "<absolute-plugin-root>/scripts/obsidian.mjs" <command> ...`
or the bundled `scripts/lib/vault.mjs` API. These share an OS-managed lock across
agent processes, vaults and plugin copies for the same user. Do not launch native
`obsidian` directly or bypass a busy guard; other tools' raw calls are not protected.
The guard waits up to 10 seconds for a turn, then fails without sending a request.
Command execution has its own 10-second default timeout. Each request is limited
to a conservative 2,048-byte UTF-8 JSON envelope and rejects physical CR/LF/NUL.
This policy is not Obsidian's documented maximum. If rejected before sending,
use filesystem Markdown editing or narrow the read query; do not split a note
into many CLI writes or disable the guard. No fallback performs writes implicitly.
For unavailable, rejected or uncertain requests, follow the direct
[app diagnosis](../../wiki-setup/references/app-access.md#failure-refusal-and-uncertain-mutation).
A timed-out mutation has an uncertain outcome: inspect the exact target before
